text: {"contradictions":[{"source":"དེ་བས་ན་བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ་ཉིད་མེད་དོ་སྙམ་དུ་དགོངས་ནས། བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་དེ་ནི་མ་ལགས་སོ་ཞེས་གསུངས་སོ།","english":"Therefore, intending to show that the Bodhisattva itself does exist, Subhuti replied: \"Blessed One, that is not so.\"","kind":"negation","why":"The source says the Bodhisattva does not exist (མེད་དོ་), but the English says it does exist.","certainty":"high"}],"omissions":[],"additions":[]}

contradictions.english: Therefore, intending to show that the Bodhisattva itself does exist, Subhuti replied: "Blessed One, that is not so."
contradictions.why: The source says the Bodhisattva does not exist (མེད་དོ་), but the English says it does exist.
